$comment: Non-secret runtime behaviour. Every secret lives in .env or in Actions secrets, never here.

schedule.$comment: Stops the same work being done twice, such as a duplicated cron delivery. Kept low so that GitHub bunching the two daily firings together cannot drop one; docs/SETUP.md has the arithmetic, and a test enforces it.

$comment: A deal reaches the shortlist when the current Steam price is at or below the historical Steam low, compared on integer minor units and never on floats.

require_new_record then narrows that shortlist to sales that BEAT every earlier price, which makes alerts much rarer on purpose: Steam repeats a title's deepest discount, so a game can sit at its all-time low again and again without ever going lower. Set it to false to hear about those too.

repeat_for_days keeps a reported deal in the payload that long, because the phone polls rather than being pushed to, and a payload published and replaced between two polls is never read. Set to 0 to publish each alert exactly once.

notification.$comment: Wording shown on the phone, so it can be in any language. The only placeholder is {count}. record_marker prefixes record-setting games, and is empty because require_new_record already restricts reports to those.

state.$comment: Entries older than this are purged, so the state file cannot grow without bound.
